source_findings.evidence: prepare applies channel-local value maps and masks unavailable sources. Structured read uses values[:, subset, band]; no other modality or band is put into that attention key/value set. Conditions affect only the query.

source_findings.check: Frequency source retention and within-source cross-band access
source_findings.evidence: In structured mode, the first attention folds only batch and source into independent rows. The subsequent B*groups by bands reshape performs cross-band attention separately for each retained source. Unavailable-source evidence is masked after read.

source_findings.check: Exact parameter-set and initialization construction of matched controls
source_findings.evidence: All three variants use the same constructor and allocation order; variant flags affect access/fusion, not registered parameter creation. build reseeds before construction. plain_twins repeats full-frequency spatial tokens and uses unrestricted source access. ordinary_frequency applies all added residual capacity to the final frequency coordinates; its first 10*dim coordinates are algebraically the original DeMo base. With the specified dim=512, output is 5632D. All added modules have a training-loss path; the independent pooling scorers feed their own identity losses, rather than existing solely for detached targets.
source_findings.limit: Actual state equality, counts, 5632D tensors, and nonzero finite gradients have not been run locally. The runtime checks are present in verify and the ten smokes.

source_findings.check: Original DeMo anchor and identity heads
source_findings.evidence: The subclass keeps the inherited backbone, reductions, generalFusion, classifier_moe/bottleneck_moe, and original direct or separate identity heads. It executes full generalFusion on original patches/globals. Base concatenates the original 3*dim and 7*dim paths, then a zero frequency slot. Training retains original identity objectives at weight 1. The original GeneralFusion is configured with reg_weight=0; no new regularization recipe was inferred from its uninspected internals.

source_findings.check: One simultaneous condition round and joint routing degeneration
source_findings.evidence: The actual forward AST calls conditions exactly once on m0/f0, then reads m1/f1 from the same original own values with the two conditions. It routes only m1/f1. Logits are a_S+c_b+psi and the mask removes whole relation rows; when psi is excluded, softmax factorizes over eligible relations and bands. The denominator substitutes one only for invalid rows, preventing their zero/zero division.
source_findings.limit: Factorization and finite-value assertions are source-verified; numerical errors were not measured here.

source_findings.check: Four controlled states, closed-expert isolation, and stopped targets
source_findings.evidence: Targets use one normalized 00 reference, one positive/negative index pair per sample selected from it, and the same direction for all four states. The entire target method is no_grad; predictor context is detached. The actual controlled_states AST used the same base object, m0/f0 pools, zero absent predictor inputs, fuse flags True/False and False/True, and precomputed full 11. No conditions, route, backbone, psi, PI, or interaction-projection path is invoked by the closed states. Source fuse gates the interaction projection on both experts enabled.
source_findings.limit: No real autograd run occurred. The verify script includes a separate requires_grad target check and CPU score recomputation for the future actual-data execution.

source_findings.evidence: The actual inference forward AST returned fused before controlled_states and target creation. It used three backbone calls. A forbidden controlled_states stub was never called.

Availability is derived from exactly-zero normalized inputs. Structured relations require all members present; unavailable values and frequency outputs are masked. Every specified case retains at least one source and thus at least one eligible singleton, so the source-level softmax support is nonempty. Invalid relation conditional pooling uses denominator one. The actual verification script enumerates r/n/t/rn/rt/nt and asserts finite descriptors, zero invalid relation mass, and unit total mass.
source_findings.limit: No real missing-modality tensor or perturbation case was executed in this review. The original shared DeMo base remains in all states, as explicitly required by the contract.

source_findings.evidence: Compared with the authorized historical revision, dual_axis.py and residual_dual_axis.py have no working-tree diff. run_experiment.py adds the new import/build branch, new variants and contribution CLI, the Axis class in the weighted-loss isinstance tuple, and V3-only receipt fields. The legacy model choices, weighting, odd auxiliary scalar handling, optimizer-step flow, GradScaler policy, train loop, and evaluation code are unchanged. Actual old/new step ASTs produced identical return values and operation order for direct/separate DeMo, ordinary/dual V1, and ordinary/dual residual V2 mocks.

source_findings.check: 13-check M0 includes the contribution-weight-zero training path
source_findings.evidence: Final preflight constructs three access checks, nine main-variant smokes, and a separate MSVR310 axis_collaboration --contribution-weight 0 smoke. Every output is unique and all use GPU0. A failure injected into the thirteenth child recorded its failed exit and raised before M0 PASS. Weight zero removes the auxiliary contribution objective only; the same calibrator still participates through gates in the fused identity path, so the source does not intentionally park its parameters.
source_findings.limit: No real zero-weight gradient or AMP tensor was tested locally.

source_findings.check: Ten-run development launcher waits, isolation, budget, and no retries
source_findings.evidence: M0 requires status PASS, exactly 13 rows, and all exit codes zero before creating the new root. Each slot reads every exact V2 predecessor exit and COMPLETE/50 result before capacity checks. Each job requires memory.used<500, receives one explicit GPU, --mode train, seed42, independent output, and its specified contribution weight. ThreadPoolExecutor has four workers. The fixed run_experiment training loop is 50 epochs. Existing campaign root raises before any new child, preventing duplicate launcher invocation. Child failure stops that slot without retry and blocks final controller output; other already-authorized slots may finish. No checkpoint reuse or official-test command is present.

source_findings.check: Local collector import chain and terminal intake
source_findings.evidence: The collector imports only stdlib helpers/schedule definitions; actual local import with external-command functions forbidden succeeded without torch or run_experiment in sys.modules. Its remote script only reads fixed V3 run JSON/text names. Completed or failed runs copy present terminal text evidence once, then write intake markers and the V3 status JSON. Repeat mock collection did not repeat any of the 90 file-copy requests. Pending-then-complete used one 240-second wait, and failure preserved a FAILED row. It never invokes the legacy helper module main, handoff synchronization, Git, training, or test scoring.

verification_scope_notes: The source smoke checks every requires_grad parameter tensor for a non-None, finite, nonzero aggregate gradient at the final smoke step. It does not claim every scalar coordinate has nonzero gradient.

Smoke reload checks strict model/optimizer deserialization and exact FP32 output before/after reloading the same model instance. This is not a fresh-process reproducibility or resumed-training-equivalence test.

The actual-data verifier uses up to eight dev records plus one training batch, normal finite outputs for the three new variants, six missing cases for structured axis_collaboration, and source/band perturbations. It does not establish complete-dataset parity, missing-case accuracy, learned utility, or every architecture operation under AMP.

Native CUDA fp16 GradScaler construction, autocast, all actual gradient tensors, FFT reconstruction, matched states/counts, structural perturbation outputs, six missing tensors, and strict checkpoint outputs remain unexecuted locally.
No local torch environment was available. The broken default python launcher and the absence of torch in E:/python.exe were observed; no installation or environmental workaround was introduced.
Final M0 coverage is 13 checks: 3 structural checks and 10 independent three-update smokes, including contribution weight zero. Only command/control-flow mock evidence exists here.
The source launcher verifies existing V2 terminal records and free capacity at runtime. CPU mocks and the old controls launch receipt do not certify that those prerequisites are currently true.

The collector is a status/text intake tool. Its terminal labels rely on the training script COMPLETE/exit outputs; this does not replace later metric, budget, sample-order, multi-seed, or integrity audits.
